reporting-org.narrative: Netherlands Advisory Board on Impact Investing

description.narrative: An influencing campaign towards institutional investors to issue a target to allocate 10% of their AuM to impact investments by 2025 and a 4% sub-target allocation to EM. The campaign targets: (1) pension funds, (2) insurance companies, (3) asset managers and (4) banks. For this, the NAB also liaises with sector organisations as Dufas, VBDO, Verbond van Verzekeraars, Zorgverzekeraars Nederland, NVB and Pensioenfederatie. In 2024, significant milestones were achieved in the 10% Target Program, including the completion of phase 1 (diagnostic study), the launch of phase 2, with active engagement with institutional investors, policymakers, and key stakeholders. Three insurance companies set a 10% target for impact. The completion of the diagnostic study “On the Way to 10% for Impact” marked the conclusion of phase 1. The study provides a comprehensive analysis of the challenges institutional investors face in scaling their impact investment allocations and serves as foundation for the NAB’s future initiatives, to help investors accelerate their impact goals. On September 25th, the NAB launched phase 2 with a Dialogue Session bringing together institutional investors, sector associations, government representatives, and regulators. This highly attended session (>40+ senior attendees) validated the findings of the diagnostic study and offered insights into potential solutions. Key themes that emerged as top priority included data availability and data management - particularly for pension funds - and impact definitions, crucial for increasing allocations with integrity, particularly in public markets.

activity-date.narrative:
The 10% Target Program is a pioneering initiative of the NAB launched with the successful hosting of the Collaborative Lunch in December of 2023. We hosted leaders from private and public financial institutions in the Netherlands to move towards a stronger collaborative and engaging ecosystem.
The 10% Target Program is tailored for Dutch institutional investors (i.e. Pension Funds, Insurers and Banks) to encourage and even facilitate institutions to issue a target to allocate a minimum of 10% of their AuM to impact investing by 2025 and further an embedded target of 4% towards emerging markets by 2030.
